message:
Manager, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Enclosure and Structural Designer and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, the wire-power balance closes on your shared cold chain.

In plain words cooling heat is not wire power until divided by hot efficiency. Reusing the single thermal total conduction respiration door pulldown fans (E109) at 13.5 kilowatt-hour thermal per day as conduction 4.87 plus respiration 1.20 plus door 0.169 from the single door model 8 curtain openings sensible plus latent (E110) plus staged pull-down 6.25 plus fans 0.96, divided by Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electric power) 1.40 at hot ambient plus controls gives 10.4 kilowatt-hour electrical per day in the term-by-term check (E128), against yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day in the grown-array yield calc (E83) leaving 3.10 kilowatt-hour margin, about one household day so everyday scale holds.

In plain words panels make extra by day and batteries run the night alone with motor-start headroom and protected shutoff. Night 18 to 6 hours load 3.02 kilowatt-hour with one cloudy day at 30 percent sun still ends at 3.73 kilowatt-hour in the battery autonomy simulation (E95) on 10.0 kilowatt-hour usable Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4, rechargeable battery chemistry), with compressor surge about 1.80 kilowatt against 2 kilowatt inverter and charge current 75.0 ampere at 48 volt in the charge current calc (E97) with Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT, solar charge optimizer) plus Low-Voltage Disconnect (LVD, automatic battery protector that sheds load) shed tied to your 8-opening staged rule from the single door model 8 curtain openings sensible plus latent (E110).

Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, from my discipline the BD50F Direct Current Compressor R134a, 12-24V DC source (E102) you put on the board confirms my conversion basis, because its 60 degree condensing hot rating justifies using derated COP 1.40 instead of catalogue COP for sizing wire power and surge at 43 degrees ambient.

My position is ready on version three, because term-by-term electrical load with hot COP, derated yield, and night plus cloudy autonomy with surge and shed now close on shared ids except field pull and 43 degree bench tests needing built hardware.
